title: Concept: Runtime floor with no upper bound
description: package.json declares an `engines.node` range that never excludes a future major, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `engines.node` range that never excludes a future major.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `engines.node` range that never excludes a future major.
